fact: Angola's tax authority AGT, per its board chairman, is developing its own machine-learning system for risk-based tax enforcement, with testing begun in 2024 and prior-hearing notices possible from June 2026.

Expansão reports AGT's chair saying the tax authority's machine-learning tools, tested since 2024, cross-checked 2025 corporate income tax filings and flagged irregular filers, who were then sent messages to correct them.
Expansão reports AGT's chair saying the AI found that 15,000 of 40,000 companies that filed zero-turnover 2025 income tax returns had in fact recorded transactions.

AGT chair Jose Leiria said on 13 April 2026 that the audit of the 2024 tax year used AI mechanisms that automatically flagged deviations and suspect cases, which then triggered prior-hearing notifications.
